title: "SAFE DISCONTINUATION OF ANTIDEPRESSANTS IN INDIVIDUALS WITH CLINICALLY REMITTED DEPRESSIVE DISORDERS"
official: "SAFE DISCONTINUATION OF ANTIDEPRESSANTS IN INDIVIDUALS WITH CLINICALLY REMITTED DEPRESSIVE DISORDERS"
summary: Main objective: The DISCARD study will compare hyperbolic with linear tapering in adults with currently remitted depression. The primary outcome will be the proportion of participants who fail to discontinue the AD by the end of the pre-defined schedule (with a tolerance period of no more than 15% of the total duration of the tapering phase) or re-initiate the AD during the 16 weeks after its discontinuation.
conditions: Patients with currently remitted depressive disorders.
